name: schemalens
description: Plugins for SchemaLens / DBSchema — design, document and explore relational database schemas from inside VS Code.

plugins.name: schemalens-vscode-extension
plugins.description: Design, document and explore relational database schemas as version-controlled text with the DBSchema VS Code extension: a .dbschema DSL plus an interactive diagram with search, dependency tracing and module grouping. Installs the extension from public GitHub Releases when missing; the VS Code Marketplace is not used.
